title: Choose the visual world for inner-balance.gr
question: The roll assigned the Greek poetry-press series. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Poetry-Press Series
options.lineage: Mid-century Greek literary editions (Ίκαρος-style flat colour covers)
options.thesis: The practice published as a numbered series: each kind of session a cover in its own colour.
options.viewport: A cypress-green cover filling the screen: his name huge, one plain sentence, a who-is-it-for picker that recolours the cover, the booking button, portrait as frontispiece.
options.risk: If the type is set timidly it reads as a bookshop, not a therapist.

raised.raise: Colour is state: choosing who the session is for floods the cover with that session's series colour.
Booking runs as fixed stations in order: who, which day and hour, send.
Selected states read in weight and a filled mark, never colour alone.
Each cover colour is owned outright at full strength, edge to edge, white type its only relief.
All accent spent in one place per screen: the saffron action.

options.label: The Harbour Horizon
options.lineage: Heraklion's Venetian harbour at dusk, sea and sky as two fields
options.thesis: Balance as a level horizon: sky field above, sea field below, the offer on the line.
options.viewport: Sky field with a large headline at the horizon, sea field below holding the sentence and the booking button.
options.risk: The sea is what most Cretan therapy, yoga and hotel sites already show; familiar.

options.label: Ikebana and Ma
options.thesis: Active emptiness: one branch of content, the rest charged space.
options.viewport: Off-centre name and one sentence in a wide plaster field, a single branch photograph.
options.case: Calm suits therapy and holds on clarity, but Heraklion visitors don't recognise a Japanese alcove as theirs.
options.risk: Too sparse: fees, hours and FAQ fight the emptiness.

options.label: Silk Canopy Chords
options.thesis: Overlapping translucent banners as colour states.
options.viewport: Crossing colour lanes over a white field.
options.risk: Abstract; says nothing about a psychologist.
options.case: Loses both axes: no audience recognition, offer gets buried.
options.kept: Colour as live state in the session picker.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: Images emerging slowly under amber light.
options.viewport: Amber field with a portrait developing.
options.risk: Moody and dim for an anxious first visit.
options.case: Loses both axes: too dark for a reassuring first step.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one calibrated rail.
options.kept: State in form, not only colour.

options.label: Single-Hue Program
options.risk: Playful to the point of trivialising.

options.label: Civic Prospectus
options.risk: Corporate, cold; violet is the generic-AI palette.
options.kept: All accent spent in one place.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A therapist site as the category ships it, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and portrait split, booking button, service cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other therapist in Heraklion, including the current site.
